name: Rule Filter Processor
description: Marks mail matching sender/subject/keyword rules as junk (gray)
author: MailFlow community
readme:
# Rule Filter Processor

Registers the processor component id `filter`. Options: `senders` (list), `subjects` (list of substrings), `keywords` (list of body substrings). Matches are classified `ad`.
